tasks.short: Counsel patients and families with information, education and reassurance.

steps.what: Find current approved patient information relevant to the counselor's actual session plan
inputs: actual session plan authored by counselor
approved patient leaflets maintained by the clinical service

steps.what: Counsel actual patients and family members through information, education and reassurance
inputs: counselor-checked relevant patient information
actual patients, family questions and emotional context
outputs: actual counseling facts and agreed next steps captured by counselor

steps.what: Write the actual counseling note and verify its meaning in the clinical record
inputs: actual counseling facts and agreed next steps captured by counselor

tasks.design: Configure a native approved-leaflet finder for the counselor, quoting the actual source rather than generating patient-specific advice. Retain session planning, applicability checks, live counseling, fresh fact capture and the actual clinical note; ordinary internal saves remain fully retained and ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating current approved educational material can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest identifies approved-leaflet lookup as a configure-first support step.
tasks.still_hard: Reassurance and the family's understanding depend on a real clinical relationship.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when information increases distress and adapt the conversation.
tasks.altitude: Bring current sources into human counseling.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an approved-leaflet finder can reduce source navigation without providing individualized genetic counseling.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the clinical record and its approved-information links. Shares15/70/15 are provisional, not measured. s1 removes3 navigation points only; source reading and applicability remain12. The counselor's existing session planning is not newly generated.

s2 counts fresh session capture and s3 actual note writing/check/save. No uncounted transcript, automated reassurance, risk assessment or patient message is proposed. No genetic information enters a new model.
unknowns: Which approved leaflets are current and already directly accessible?
research_questions: Observe actual source navigation separately from education and emotional support.

incremental.description: Maintain current approved-leaflet links and remove superseded sources.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 source-navigation points less0.5 upkeep. Low: a rare condition lacks a directly indexed leaflet and needs manual source review, leaving only0.8 general-information navigation points removable, less0.5 upkeep. Counseling70 and clinical note15 remain.

tasks.short: Analyze actual genetic information to identify individual or family risk.

steps.what: Verify actual laboratory reports and patient-provided family information and clarify missing facts
inputs: actual laboratory reports produced by the laboratory
actual family information supplied by patient and collected by counselor
outputs: verified genetic and family information with explicit gaps

steps.what: Retrieve current clinical reference sources selected by the counselor for interpretation
inputs: verified genetic and family information with explicit gaps
current clinical references maintained by the service

steps.what: Analyze actual genetic information and determine clinically appropriate individual or family risk interpretation
inputs: verified genetic and family information with explicit gaps
counselor-checked interpretation references

steps.what: Write and check the actual risk interpretation in the internal clinical record
inputs: human clinical interpretation and uncertainty
verified genetic and family information with explicit gaps

tasks.design: Use direct native links to the counselor's selected current reference sources, reducing navigation rather than clinical analysis. Retain source verification, missing-family-fact capture, all genetic risk interpretation and the actual authored clinical record; no diagnostic or risk model is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated reference navigation can sit around actual interpretation work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical reference links can expose chosen sources directly.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete family information and uncertain findings require expert interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a source does not support the apparent conclusion for this family.
tasks.altitude: Keep interpretation accountable while improving source access.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct source links can reduce retrieval without analyzing genetic information or calculating patient risk.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the clinical record/reference launcher. Shares30/15/45/10 are provisional, not measured. Only3 points of s2 repeated navigation disappear; reading and applicability remain12.

research_questions: Separate source navigation from source reading and clinical analysis in a real case.

incremental.description: Maintain current clinical source links and access checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 source-navigation points less0.8 upkeep. tasks.short: Provide actual specialist genetic counseling in the relevant clinical area.

steps.what: Review actual specialty records and establish the patient's current counseling context
inputs: actual specialty records supplied by care team
actual patient questions and history clarified by counselor
outputs: verified specialty context and explicit uncertainties

steps.what: Provide actual obstetric, pediatric, oncology or neurology genetic counseling and capture session facts
inputs: verified specialty context and explicit uncertainties
actual patient and family
outputs: counselor-authored session notes and actual agreed next steps

steps.what: Write the consultation record from actual counselor-authored session notes
inputs: counselor-authored session notes and actual agreed next steps
verified specialty context and explicit uncertainties

loop.purpose: Restate supplied counseling notes as a proposed consultation record
loop.input: counselor-authored session notes, actual agreed next steps and verified specialty context
loop.output: proposed note preserving uncertainty and exact source references
loop.check: Counselor checks every assertion and omission against notes and lab records, including exact variant wording, risk figures, uncertainty and agreed actions; no added clinical inference is accepted
loop.stop: Missing notes, unapproved processing route or two failed meaning checks returns drafting to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native specialty-note headings first; only variable restatement prose needs a bounded loop

steps.what: Check full consultation meaning against notes and laboratory sources and save the internal record
inputs: complete proposed consultation record
counselor-authored session notes and actual agreed next steps
actual laboratory records already in specialty context

tasks.design: Use the existing specialty-note structure and a bounded restatement draft from actual counselor-authored notes. Keep specialty review, actual counseling, fresh capture, clinical interpretation and full meaning checking human; the ordinary internal record save has no separate approval gate or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Restating already captured session facts can repeat work after specialist counseling.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest documents consultation-note drafting capability, while this narrower design uses supplied notes without assuming free ambient capture.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical meaning, uncertainty and family understanding remain human responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Notice that a grammatically clear note has changed the meaning of uncertain information.
tasks.altitude: Check faithful documentation while remaining the specialist counselor.

evidence.claim: The digest documents Autoscriber drafting structured consultation notes into EHRs; it does not measure time saved for genetic counseling.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the clinical record. Shares20/60/15/5 are provisional, not measured. s2 explicitly counts fresh counselor note capture; no free transcript, unapproved patient recording or automatic diagnostic inference is assumed.

Only3 points of s3 restatement disappear; all substantive writing/revision remains12 and final clinical checking5 stays full. Use only an institution-approved genetic-data processing route; otherwise draft manually. This is an internal note, not an automated patient letter or clinical order.
unknowns: Can actual session notes be processed in the institution's approved documentation route?
research_questions: Compare a proposed note against source notes for lost uncertainty and new clinical implications.

incremental.description: Maintain specialty-note constraints and inspect recurrent meaning failures.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 restatement points less0.7 upkeep. Low: complex family uncertainty needs manual clinical wording throughout, leaving only1 point of straightforward session-fact restatement removable, less0.7 upkeep. Specialty review20, actual counseling/capture60 and full check5 remain.

tasks.short: Discuss testing options, risks, benefits and limitations for informed decisions.

steps.what: Select and verify actual testing-options leaflets against the clinician's patient-specific discussion plan
inputs: actual testing discussion plan authored by counselor
approved testing-options information maintained by clinical service
outputs: verified testing-options sources with risks, benefits and limitations

steps.what: Discuss actual testing choices, risks, benefits and limitations and explore family understanding
inputs: verified testing-options sources with risks, benefits and limitations
actual patients and family preferences and questions
outputs: actual discussion facts and patient decision or uncertainty captured by counselor

steps.what: Write the actual testing discussion and decision or uncertainty in the clinical record
inputs: actual discussion facts and patient decision or uncertainty captured by counselor

tasks.design: Expose the current approved testing-options sources through native information links for the counselor. Remove only repeated source navigation; the actual option discussion, informed decision support, fresh capture and authored clinical note remain human, with no automated test order or recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant approved risk/benefit information may require repeated retrieval.
tasks.enabler_now: A native source finder can quote the approved source directly.
tasks.still_hard: The family's understanding and values cannot be reduced to a leaflet lookup.
tasks.human_edge: Explore a patient's uncertainty without pushing a test choice.
tasks.altitude: Use current information while protecting informed choice.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct approved-source links can reduce testing-information navigation without choosing a test or counseling a family.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the clinical record's approved-information view. Shares15/70/15 are provisional, not measured. s1 removes3 navigation points only; checking current applicability remains12.

The actual patient decision and discussion are captured in s2 and written in s3, including ordinary ungated save. No inferred consent, test booking, diagnostic calculator, patient chatbot or automatic send is proposed. This record must not be counted again as a second note in a broader counseling task.
unknowns: Which actual testing leaflets are indexed and current?
research_questions: Observe retrieval separately from actual risk/benefit discussion and decision recording.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 source-navigation points less0.5 upkeep. Low: an unusual test lacks a directly indexed leaflet and requires manual evidence checking, leaving only0.7 general testing-information navigation points removable, less0.5 upkeep. Actual discussion70 and decision record15 remain.
